run_transform_trees_reverse: run transform_trees.py to reverse parse trees from input file to output file
run_transform_trees_left_branching: run transform_trees.py to create left-branching binary trees from input file
run_transform_trees_right_branching: run transform_trees.py to create right-branching binary trees from input file
run_transform_trees_doc_level: run transform_trees.py to transform document-level trees with DOC root nodes
run_transform_trees_no_preterms: run transform_trees.py to transform trees without preterminals or POS tags
